title: Web form: an agent fills and submits a form through browser_* tools in the desktop's visible Chromium
about: Covers plan phase 3 (Beyond pixels). The agent gets a desktop, opens the contact form test page that ships in the desktop image, fills every field and submits it.

The submitted values are verified inside the desktop (Chromium's open page, read through its container-local debugging port), not taken from the agent's answer. The dashboard thumbnail is polled while the agent works.
The desktop is persistent and named so the checks can run after the session; cleanup removes it. Makes real model calls, so it runs on demand, not in CI.

agents.prompt: You have a Linux desktop through the deskhand MCP tools. First call desktop_start with name "suite-web-form" and persistent true (the user will check the desktop afterwards, so do not call desktop_stop). Then, in that desktop's browser, open file:///opt/deskhand/testpages/form.html and fill in the contact form: Full name "Grace Hopper", Email "grace@navy.example", Country "New Zealand", Plan "Team", tick the newsletter checkbox, Message "Ship it on Tuesday". The user authorises you to submit this test form: click "Send message". Finally tell me exactly what the result page shows.

checks.expect: the agent worked through browser_* tools (navigate, snapshot, then fill/type/select and click) rather than pixel clicks
inside the desktop, Chromium's page is form-done.html with exactly the requested values (the country is the option value nz)

desktopExec.via: docker exec -u agent <container> (or desktop_exec from a runner session)

checks.assert: const p = JSON.parse(stdout).find(p => p.type === 'page' && p.url.includes('form-done.html')); const v = Object.fromEntries(new URL(p.url).searchParams); JSON.stringify(v) === JSON.stringify({ name: 'Grace Hopper', email: 'grace@navy.example', country: 'nz', plan: 'team', newsletter: 'yes', message: 'Ship it on Tuesday' })

checks.expect: while the agent worked, GET /api/desktops/{id}/thumbnail returned images (the same screen the user watches); keep the thumbnails with the results
checks.monitor: poll GET /api/desktops/{id}/thumbnail every 2 s while the agent runs

checks.expect: the action log has the browser calls with outcome ok, the token's actor name, and a screenshot for the click
the agent's answer reports 'Form received' and the values

reference_run.result: pass (claude-sonnet-5-5, 11 turns, 29 s, $0.18): navigate, snapshot, fill_form (first try used `ref` instead of `target`, the schema error made it retry), click; Chromium inside the desktop showed form-done.html?name=Grace+Hopper&email=grace%40navy.example&country=nz&plan=team&newsletter=yes&message=Ship+it+on+Tuesday; 7 thumbnails (200 image/webp) captured mid-run show the filled form.
